## [1.21.1](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/compare/v1.21.0...v1.21.1) (2026-11-03)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Discord - Keep media playing:** Fixed the notification's skip buttons not moving its seek bar ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))
* **Discord - Keep media playing:** Fixed the notification staying after returning to Discord with buttons that did nothing ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))
* **Discord - Keep media playing:** Fixed a video in the small window resetting, losing its place and coming back with an off-center play button ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))
* **Discord - Expand the message bar:** Fixed the post header in threads and forum posts covering the open bar's collapse button ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))
* **Discord - Show timeout duration:** Fixed the timeout tag lagging behind and saying 1m for a whole minute instead of counting down ([#145](https://github.com/VenusIsJaded/Venus-Patches/issues/145))

* **Discord - Send long messages:** Fixed a sticker sent with long typed text being refused, losing both the sticker and the text

SysAdminDoc/HushGram.Changelog:
Almost all of this release came from your requests. You can keep your own list of saved profiles with folders, and the glass tab bar can tick and click as you move between tabs. Settings categories now open on their own pages. The fix list below is a long one.

New in this release

- With `Page dots on a pill` on, you can hold the pill and slide left or right to flip through a carousel's pages, a page for each dot, the way Instagram's own dots work. Asked for in #651.

- `Hide Watch more reels` sits under `Watch again in the feed` in Feed. When a reel in your feed ends, the card it shows keeps Watch again and drops the big Watch more reels button. Starts off. Asked for in #652.

- `Shrink the pill as you scroll` in Tab bar shrinks the pill while you scroll down and restores it on the way up, with `Liquid glass look` off. `Hide the tab bar as you scroll` wins. Needs a restart. Asked for in #638.

- `Burn-in guard` fades the Add comment bar under a reel too, along with the other buttons, and tapping it brings them all back. Asked for in #648.

- `Open Saved profiles with a tab long press` under `Your saved profiles` in Profiles lets you pick a tab, Profile included, that opens your saved list when you hold it. A normal tap works as before. Needs `Saved profiles` on. Asked for in #629.

- `Fast scroll in Saved` under `Saved tab on your profile` in Profiles shows a handle at the right edge of Saved and your collections while you scroll. Drag it to jump anywhere. No restart needed. Starts off. Asked for in #644.

- `Keep the tab bar on Favorites` in Feed leaves the tab bar showing in Favorites. `Open Favorites with a tab long press` opens it from a tab you hold. Both ship in `Start Home on Following` and start off. Asked for in #643.

- A story's three dot menu has `Add to Stories priority`, which adds that account to your `Priority accounts` list and turns `Stories priority` on if needed. For someone already listed, it reads `Remove from Stories priority`. Asked for in #641.

- `Double tap to skip` in Reels and `Double tap to skip on feed videos` in Feed each get a `Skip length` slider, 5 to 30 seconds in steps of 5. It starts at 10, and the feed's arrows show it. Asked for in #645.

- `Haptic strength` in Tab bar sets the glass tab bar's tick from 25% to 200%. `Tap sound on the tab bar` clicks as the highlight moves, at the `Tap sound volume` you pick, except in silent or vibrate mode. Asked for in #640.

- `Glass in chats` now frosts a chat's message bar too, so messages blur as they scroll under it. `Glass reply box on stories`, new under Stories, gives the Send message box on stories the same glass. Starts off. Asked for in #391.

- `Launch screen in the accent color` in Layout fills the startup screen with your accent color, or Instagram's blue with `Accent color` off. A typed color shows as the nearest listed one, since Android draws that screen first. Starts off. Asked for in #528.

- `Seek bar position` under `Seek bar on stories` has `Below the Send message box`, which moves the story seek bar under the reply box. Where there's no room there, it stays above the box. Asked for in #636.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, Home's `See-through top bar`, a chat's glass header and message bar, and the story reply box get the pill's soft shine. `Bend light at the edges` bends their edges the way the pill's rim does. Asked for in #513 and #391.

- `Hide Subscribe on posts` sits under `Hide Follow on posts` in Feed. It takes just the Subscribe button off the top of posts in your feed, so Follow stays where it is. Starts off. Asked for in #622.

- `Hide the Create button on saved reels` in Reels takes the plus button off reels you open from Saved or a collection, and leaves it everywhere else. Starts off. Asked for in #620.

- `Speed in the story menu` under `Speed button on stories` moves Playback speed (1x, 1.5x, 2x) into a video story's three dot menu, and the story waits while you pick. Needs `Download any story` in your build. Starts off. Asked for in #621.

- `Keep photo locations from Instagram` under Ads and privacy stops Instagram reading where the photos and videos in your gallery were taken. Starts off. Asked for in #628.

- `Keep profile history` under Profiles remembers each profile's username, bio and picture, on your phone only. A toast says when one changed, and `Profile changes` lists every old one with a search box. Asked for in #590 and #611.

- HushGram's settings are now in Thai, thanks to MangaThatsFine in #593.

- `Hide the Join bar on channel posts` under Feed takes away the bar under a post that asks you to join the account's channel. The post stays. Starts off. Asked for in #625.

- New switches under Profiles take the Threads badge, Facebook and WhatsApp links, the profile song, interests, channel invites and the other banners from under the bio on other people's profiles. Yours keeps them. Each starts off. Asked for in #627.

- `Hide Reply on comments` sits under `Hide comments` in Comments. It takes Reply off each comment on posts and reels, and View more replies still opens a thread. Starts off. Asked for in #619.

- `Ask before a follow` under Profiles asks "Follow @username?" before a Follow or Follow back button follows anyone, on a profile or in a Followers or Following list. Other Follow buttons, like the one on stories, ask too. Starts off. Asked for in #631.

- `Saved profiles` in Profiles adds Save profile to anyone's profile menu, kept on your phone apart from Instagram's Favorites and Following. `Your saved profiles` lists them with search and folders you name. Settings exports carry the list. Starts off. Asked for in #629.

- `Hide the Like button on stories`, `Hide the Comment button on stories` and `Hide the Share button on stories` under Stories take those buttons off other people's stories, leaving no gap. Each starts off. Asked for in #618.

- `Keep hidden accounts in Favorites` sits under `Hidden accounts` in Feed. Turn it on and posts from accounts you've hidden still show when Home is on Favorites, while For you and Following leave them out. Starts off. Asked for in #601.

- `Hide posts from business and creator accounts` under Feed takes their posts out of Home and Following, friends who use one included, and collabs with one of them too. Favorites still shows them. Starts off. Asked for in #579.

- `Lock Saved` sits with the message locks in Messages. Saved, your collections and the search inside Saved stay covered until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you, and your messages stay as they were. Starts off. Asked for in #597.

- `Mute button on reels` under Reels puts a speaker icon beside a reel. Tap it to turn sound off or on. `Mute button in clear mode` keeps it in clear mode too. Both start off. Asked for in #608.

- `Upload stories at full quality` adds `Video resolution` up to 2160p, `Video frame rate` to 120 fps, `Photo quality` to 100 and `Photo size` to 8192 px. Settings past what your phone's encoder handles drop back. Instagram still re-encodes them. Asked for in #37.

- `Loop this video` in a feed video's or reel's menu loops just that one while `Stop videos looping` is on. `Loop this story` does the same for a story while `Loop a story` is off. Asked for in #610.

- `Seek bar shape` under Feed gives the seek bars on feed videos, stories and reels a new look: a thin line, a thicker rounded bar, a bar split by a tall handle, or a wave. They grow while you drag. Asked for in #586 and #592.

- `Preview while you drag a seek bar` under Feed shows the time above your finger on feed videos, stories and reels, plus a picture of that moment or the paused video itself. Asked for in #567 and #592.

- `Keep the tab bar on a reel's profile` keeps the tab bar on a profile you open from a reel, and Back goes back to the reel. It starts off, in the Reels section of HushGram settings.

- `Swipe right on Home opens` picks what that swipe does: the camera, as it is now, or Search, Reels, Messages or Profile. Asked for in #589.

- `Picture in picture for reels` under Playback, below `Keep playing in the background`, shrinks a playing reel into a small window over other apps when you leave Instagram. Needs Android 15 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #572.

- `Picture in picture for stories` under Playback does the same for stories. Leave Instagram while one plays and it shrinks into a small window that keeps going through the stories. Starts off. Asked for in #572.

- `Show it on the profile picture` under `Mark who doesn't follow you back` swaps the words for a badge on each profile picture in your Following list. Green check means they follow back, red cross means they don't. Starts off. Asked for in #572.

- New patch, `Search comments`. Its switch under Comments puts a search box above a post's comments. Type a word or name to jump to the next match, loading more as needed. Arrows step between matches. Unopened replies aren't searched. Asked for in #560.

- New patch, `Split the notes row`. Its switch under Messages splits the notes row at the top of your messages into three stacks (Instants, Notes and Stories), the layout Instagram is testing on some accounts. Takes a restart. Asked for in #558.

- New patch, `Hide Instagram Plus prompts`. Its switch under Ads and privacy takes the Try Instagram Plus card and See preview row off a chat you hold, plus other Plus offers shown the same way. Nothing from Plus turns on. Asked for in #559.

- `Hide the Community Standards reminder` under Messages takes the "Help keep Instagram a supportive place" banner off the bottom of a chat. Asked for in #588.

- `Who can call you` under Messages stops Instagram calls from ringing your phone: nobody, only people on your list, or everyone except them. Callers just get no answer. Asked for in #578.

- `Hide page number` under Feed takes the number like 3/5 off the corner of a carousel post. Starts off. Asked for in #581.

- `Hide story rows` under Feed takes out the rows of stories Instagram puts between posts on Home, like Expiring Stories. It's off until you turn it on. Asked for in #557.

- `Swipe through a chat's photos and posts` under Messages lets you open a photo, video or shared post from a chat and swipe up through the chat's other photos, videos and shared posts, in chat order. Asked for in #350.

- `Seek bar on photos with music` under Reels gives a reel that's a photo with a song the same seek bar and time as a video reel, following the song. Asked for in #10.

- `Jump a profile's posts to a date` puts a calendar on a profile's top bar. Pick a day and the posts grid goes back to that day, with older posts as you scroll. Asked for in #498.

- `Hide GIFs in comments` under Comments takes GIFs and stickers out of comments and the GIF button off the comment box. A comment with words keeps them. Asked for in #511.

- `Solid story rings` sits under `Story rings in the accent color` and makes a story's ring one shade of your color instead of running light to dark. Asked for in #519.

- `Ask what to save` under `Download button on reels` lets a tap on the icon pick the reel, its cover or its sound, whichever it has. A reel with nothing else to save still saves at once. Asked for in #524.

- `Save videos as MKV` under Downloads saves .mkv files instead of .mp4, for gallery apps that show blank thumbnails for VP9 or AV1. Nothing is re-encoded, and the account, date and link stay in. One-file videos stay .mp4. Asked for in #547.

- `Hide the search bar` under Sharing takes the search bar off the top of the share sheet. Asked for in #545.

- `Speed button on reels` has 2.5x in its list too, for talking videos that are still easy to follow past 2x. Asked for in #551.

- `Speed in the reel menu` under Reels adds Playback speed to the menu a reel's three dots open. Tap it and pick a speed from 0.5x to 3x, so the speed icon can stay off the reel. Asked for in #553.

- New patch, `Double tap to skip on Reels`. Its switch under Reels turns on Instagram's skip, 10 seconds back on the left, ahead on the right. The middle still likes. `A tap on a reel` has `Keep playing` now too. Asked for in #554.

- New patch, `Hold for 2x on feed videos`. Turn on its switch under Feed, then press and hold a video in your feed and it plays at 2x with Instagram's own speed-up. Let go and it's back to normal speed. Asked for in #552.

- New patch, `Hide the 2x popup on Reels`. Its switch under Reels takes the 2x label off a reel while you hold it to play faster, and the speed-up keeps working. Asked for in #552.

- `Tab icon size` under Tab bar draws the icons on the bottom tab bar bigger, from 110% up to 150% of Instagram's size. It works on Instagram's bar and the glass one, and a change shows right away. Asked for in #541.

- `Count on the heart` under Tab bar puts a number on the heart at the top of Home, like the one on Messages, instead of the red dot. It takes a restart. Asked for in #541.

- `History button on Home's header` under Tab bar puts a clock at the top of Home. One tap opens your viewing history. It starts off. Asked for in #228.

- `Accent color` has a `Custom` choice now, with a `Custom color` row for any hex color like #4A6B82. HushGram adjusts it where text would be hard to read. On Android 10 and older, only some colors take it. Asked for in #520.

- `Accent color` also has three calmer colors: Dusk blue, Pine and Slate. Asked for in #528.

- `Categories on their own page` under Settings entry opens a category on its own page, name at the top, instead of under its row. Back returns to the same spot in the list. Needs `Expandable categories` on. Asked for in #525.

- The viewing history has its own category in settings now, instead of sitting under Ads and privacy. Each row shows a picture, like a post's first photo, a reel's cover or a person's profile photo. Asked for in #228.

- Viewing history pictures load from Instagram's image servers once and stay on your phone. `Clear viewing history` deletes them with the list. Hold a row for `Copy link`, `Open profile` or `Remove from history`. Asked for in #228.

- `Double tap to skip on feed videos` under Feed makes a double tap on a video's left side go back 10 seconds and the right go ahead 10. Arrows flash where you tapped. The middle still likes. Starts off. Asked for in #562.

- New patch, `Hide lives in Reels`. Its switch under Reels leaves out the live broadcasts Instagram slips in between reels, on the Reels tab and when you swipe through reels you opened from Explore. Asked for in #566.

- New patch, `Save in the post menu`. Its switch under Feed adds Save (or Remove from saved) to the menu behind a post's three dots. `Hide the Save button` next to it takes the bookmark off feed posts. Asked for in #569.

- New patch, `Hide Made with Edits`. Its switch under Feed takes the "Made with Edits" label out of the line under a post's author, and the song, the place and the other labels keep taking turns there. Asked for in #570.

- New patch, `Watch again in the feed`. With its switch on under Feed, Watch again at the end of a reel in your feed plays it over in place instead of opening Reels. `Watch more reels` still opens Reels. Asked for in #568.

- `Seek bar on the bottom edge` under `Seek bar on feed videos` moves the bar down onto the video's bottom edge, so a scroll is less likely to catch it. Asked for in #567.

- `Take a scroll break` now lets you pick how long you scroll, from 5 minutes up to 2 hours, and a `Break length` slider sets the break from 5 to 120 minutes. Asked for in #297.

- `Stop background feed refresh` under Battery stops the job that wakes your phone about every half hour to fetch your feed. Your feed loads when you open Instagram, and messages and notifications still come in. Reported in #341.

- `Ask before a like` covers reels now. Tap the heart on a reel and it asks "Like or unlike this post?" first, same as in the feed. Asked for in #603.

- `Ask before a like` asks about the heart beside a comment too, so a stray tap doesn't like it. Double tapping a comment still likes it straight away. Asked for in #614.

- `Ask for each chat` under `Lock your messages` asks you to unlock every chat you open, and the inbox when you go back. Off, one unlock covers everything until you leave Instagram. Starts off. Asked for in #649.

Fixes

- `Glass tab bar` no longer flickers to its plain tint while you swipe through the feed or messages, and a video under it keeps its blur instead of flashing sharp. The other glass bars and backgrounds get it too. Reported in #429.

- A settings restore now puts a saved profile with no folder into the folder the file has for it, and Undo takes it back out. Before, only newly added profiles got their folders. Asked about in #629.

- With `Carousel arrows` on, scrolling the feed with your finger starting on an arrow now scrolls it. Before, the arrow held on to the touch and the feed didn't move.

- `Default playback quality` no longer leaves a reel stuttering on a slow connection. A video that falls behind now steps down one quality at a time, and new videos start no higher than that for two minutes. Reported in #599.

- With `Lock your messages` on, opening a chat from a notification no longer sends Seen or clears the unread mark before you unlock. Seen goes once you unlock, unless `Read messages without the seen receipt` holds it. Reported in #649.

- With `Glass tab bar` floating, the story camera's bottom row (gallery button, Story, Reel and Live picker) no longer sits under the navigation buttons. The glass also stops blurring while the camera's open, so the camera has less to do. Reported in #646.

- With `See-through top bar` on, Instagram no longer keeps redrawing the screen after you leave Home for another tab, which used battery even on a still screen. Found while building #513.

- `Glass in chats` now shows up as soon as a chat opens. If the chat sat still right after it opened, the top bar and message bar could stay plain until you scrolled. Found while checking #391.

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, the floating tab bar now steps aside in an open chat instead of covering the reply box on Android 17. Reported in #632.

- With `Full screen Reels`, `Full screen Home` or `Full screen Messages` hiding the bars, the comment box no longer slips below the bottom of the screen on some Samsung phones. Reported in #626.

- `Hide the Create button on reels` now also takes the plus button off reels you open from Saved, a profile or a post, which get a different top bar on 454. Found while building #620.

- A reel link opened from another app now plays that reel first, instead of a reel Instagram had saved or fetched ahead. It's the new `Open reel links on that reel` switch under Reels, on to start. Reported in #606.

- `Recent unfollowers` now saves your Followers list when Instagram shows a few fewer accounts than your follower count, like 547 of 550. Before, nothing was saved. It allows one missing account per 50 followers. Reported in #624.

- With `Stories fill the screen` on, a reel shared to a story fills the screen right away, without the rounded card and reply bar showing first, and its sides no longer get cut off. Reported in #618.

- With `Tab bar layout` set to a bar Instagram didn't pick, a tab like Home no longer opens blank after Android closes Instagram in the background. HushGram builds the missing page again. Reported in #535.

- Picking `Download` or `Loop this story` in a story's menu plays the story on once the menu closes. It used to stay paused until you tapped it. Reported in #610.

- Home stops asking for more pages after a few short ones again, with `Hide suggested posts` or another Feed switch taking most of each page out. Instagram's own page loads kept starting the count over. Reported in #579.

- The `See who a story mentions` list opens again when you come back to the story after opening a post on a profile you picked from it. Before, it only came back if you didn't tap anything on that profile. Reported in #403.

- With `Peek at the next carousel page` on, Instagram no longer crashes while you scroll Home past carousels. When Instagram reused a carousel for another post, it could look for a page slot the carousel no longer had.

- With `Peek at the next carousel page` on, `Ambient light` glows around the smaller page you see instead of leaving a square behind it, where the full-size page would have been. Reported in #585.

SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger.Changelog:
HushMessenger for Messenger 587.0.0.54.96, all 19 arm64 and armv7 builds, which needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. 98 patches. Calls can show live captions now, and unsent messages can stay in encrypted chats too. You can blur the chat list behind menus, send an Instant from your gallery, see when someone you track comes online and hide the Stories tab. Source updates don't change installed apps.

### New in this release

- `Hide Stories tab` is a new switch under Navigation. It takes the Stories tab out of the bottom bar after a restart, like the People and Notifications switches do. Refs #170.
- `Use the phone's camera app` has a new `Ask photo or video` option. The camera button asks which one you want and opens your camera app for it, so you can record videos too. Refs #168.
- `Mark as seen button` is a new switch under `View stories anonymously`. Stories you open get an eye with a slash through it while you're watching anonymously. Tap it and you show up in that story's viewer list, the way you would without the patch. The next story stays anonymous. Refs #169.
- `Send Instants from your gallery` is a new switch under Photos and videos. Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your gallery app, and the photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Refs #161.
- `Special contacts` is a new switch under Chat menu. Press and hold a chat with one person and tap Track this person. From then on HushMessenger writes down when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, using only what Messenger already shows you. Settings lists everyone you track with the last thing seen, their history, and buttons to clear it or stop tracking. You can track up to 50 people per account, and it all stays on this phone. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #163.
- `Blur behind menus` is a new switch under Theme. When you press and hold a chat, the chat list behind the menu blurs like it does on an iPhone, and so does the screen behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets. It needs Android 12 or newer. Phones that can't blur behind a window (some Samsungs can't, and battery saver turns it off on others) get Messenger's own screen blurred under the menu instead. The `iPhone look` quick setup turns it on too. Experimental, and it starts off. Refs #162.
- `Live captions on calls` is a new switch under Calls. While you're on a call, what the other people say shows up as captions near the bottom of the screen, made by your phone's own speech recognition. Under the switch you pick the language they speak and the one you want to read, and if your phone can translate on the device the captions come out in your language. `Read captions aloud` reads each one in the phone's voice, and `Lower their voice while reading` turns them down while it does. It needs Android 13 or newer. It's experimental and starts off. Refs #159.
- `Row in the chat menu`, under `Keep a message log`, adds Message log to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. Tap it and the log opens on just that chat's messages, and `All chats` takes you back to everything. It starts off. Refs #172.
- If `GmsCore support` is patched in but microG-RE isn't installed (or is turned off), the top of the HushMessenger settings says so now, since Messenger can't get notifications through Google's push service that way. `Copy setup` also gets a `Push:` line saying which push service Messenger is set up to use. Refs #173.
- The settings screen is in Turkish now. Refs #160.
- The settings screen is in Thai now, translated by MangaThatsFine. Refs #166.
- Switches that came with an update get a dot next to their name until you've seen their page, and so do their section and tab. TalkBack says "New" after the name. Refs #149.
- Material You gets a `Palette style` picker with the same choices as Android's wallpaper settings: Tonal spot, Neutral, Vibrant, Expressive, Rainbow, Fruit salad and Monochrome. A new `Light mode grays` switch tints Messenger's light-mode grays with your palette too, and white and black stay put. Refs #155.
- `Bigger chat preview` gives the preview most of the screen when you press and hold a chat, and you can scroll back through the chat right there. The menu under it stays short and scrolls. Refs #151.
- `Hide chat menu items` lets you pick what the press-and-hold menu on a chat shows. Press and hold any chat once and its items show up under the switch, ready to hide the ones you never use. Messenger always keeps at least one of its own. Refs #153.
- Two new switches under Navigation. `Hide the tab bar while scrolling` slides the bottom tab bar away as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. `Floating tab bar` turns on the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats. Both take a Messenger restart. Refs #154.

### Fixes and changes

- The patches are built with Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, the one that comes with Morphe Manager 2.5.0 and Morphe Desktop 2.1.0. Manager won't load a bundle made with a newer patcher than its own, so update Manager to 2.5.0 or newer (or Desktop to 2.1.0) before you add this release.
- The patches now take Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 and drop 586. All 19 of 587's builds on APKMirror are covered. Refs #145.
- Videos in chat heads play like the rest of the chat now. On some phones Messenger 587 draws videos on a layer of their own, and a chat head could show that layer as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. In a chat head, or a bubble on Android 12 and newer, the video is drawn inside the chat instead. Videos in the app itself are unchanged. Refs #104.
- The switches for the menu you get when you press and hold a chat moved out of Inbox into their own Chat menu group, both in HushMessenger settings and in Morphe's patch list. Inbox had gotten long.
- The message log keeps up to 20,000 messages now, up from 5,000. Refs #172.
- `Keep unsent messages` works in encrypted chats too. When someone unsends a message there, it stays in the chat marked [unsent], as long as Messenger already showed you its words (in the chat or a notification) and hasn't restarted since. Refs #172.
- With `Spoof package version` on, parts of Messenger still saw the raised version number, like its background job check and its crash reports, because they get the app's version info in roundabout ways the patch didn't follow. Now every place Messenger reads a version number asks first whose it is. Messenger's own answers with the build you patched, and other apps keep the number Android gives. Refs #120.
- `Hide call buttons` and the call confirmation work again. Messenger 586 started wrapping a chat's audio and video call buttons in another button, and the patch was looking at the wrapper. Refs #146.
- `Ask before a call` asks on every call button now, including the ones outside a chat's top bar. A business chat and the New message screen build their own call buttons, so a tap there used to start the call right away. Refs #172.
- `Hide call buttons` takes the call buttons off business chats and the New message screen too. Those two screens build their own, so they used to stay. Refs #146, #172.
- On 586 a call crashed as it started when `Record calls` was on. The recording setup now takes its size from Messenger's own instead of 585's. Refs #146.
- The Experimental badge stays on one line. A long title used to squeeze it into a tall strip of one or two letters per line. Now it sits under the title when the two don't fit side by side. Refs #157.
- When a Meta-signed Messenger was uninstalled with its data kept, the install check told you to patch a higher version, which can't work for a build Meta signed. It points you at `Clone install` now, or at removing the leftover if you don't need its data. Refs #156.
- Patching goes faster. The code that finds where each patch goes had grown too big for Java to compile, so it ran slowly. It's split into smaller pieces now, and the slowest step takes about half as long on a computer. Refs #148, #150.
- `Android Auto messages` also works on accounts where Messenger leaves the car part out of its notifications. Messenger only adds it when a setting on Meta's side says so, and the switch turns that on. Refs #75.
- `Report a problem` reads Messenger's notification channels right again. Messenger 586 started adding a code to the end of each channel's name, so the report listed every one of them as unknown. Refs #158.
- A Root Mount over a different Messenger build now gets a warning instead of a mystery crash. Several builds share one version name, and mounting a patch made from one over another crashed chat heads. HushMessenger names the build Android has installed in a toast, under the name in settings and in `Copy setup`, so you know which one to patch. Refs #158.
- `Hide Your story when sharing` now also stops the "Chats or Your story" question some phones ask on every share. Xiaomi's share sheet groups an app's targets, and Messenger switched its story target back on at every launch, so you had to pick each time. With the switch on, sharing a photo goes straight to Chats. Refs #147.
- `Log chats that don't notify`, under `Keep a message log`, also saves messages from muted and restricted chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, without a notification. Those chats used to stop before the log could see the message. Now they go through to the log and the notification is dropped right before it would show. Unsends still get marked, and auto reply leaves those chats alone. Refs #143.
- Patching in Morphe Manager holds less memory. One of the `Android Auto messages` lookups kept a copy of every APK it had read for as long as the patches stayed loaded, so patching a second time carried the first APK along. It lets go once it's done now. Refs #75.
- Patching does less work. The steps that look for chat heads, Material You colors and home screen shortcuts now skip code that can't match before reading it, and in testing on a computer a full patch used about a fifth less processor time. The patched app comes out exactly the same.
- Patching is quicker again. The step that finds where each switch goes used to read through Messenger's code once per switch, and now it reads it once for all of them. In testing on a computer a full patch took a little over half the processor time it did before, and the patched app is byte for byte the same.
- `GmsCore support` only tells Messenger that Google Play services is there while microG-RE is installed and turned on. It used to say yes either way, so without microG-RE Messenger kept reaching for an app that wasn't there. Now it carries on the way it does on a phone with no Play services. On Android 14 and newer, a phone without microG-RE also keeps Android's own sign-in route, so a password manager can still offer a saved login.
- A chat pinned with `Pin more chats` loses its pin mark as soon as you unpin it. The mark used to stay on the chat until Messenger restarted, even though Unpin had worked. Refs #56.

### Behind the scenes

- For developers, `scripts/CompatReport.java` is a small launcher now. The report it runs lives in `scripts/compat/`, one file per group of patches instead of one file of nearly 12,000 lines, and you start it the same way as before.

### Reports this release changed something for

#56, #75, #104, #120, #143, #145, #146, #147, #148, #149, #150, #151, #153, #154, #155, #156, #157, #158, #159, #160, #161, #162, #163, #166, #168, #169, #170, #172 and #173.

Full history is in the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushMessenger/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

### How to update

1. Update Messenger to 587.0.0.54.96 first. On [APKMirror's 587.0.0.54.96 page](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/facebook-2/messenger/facebook-messenger-587-0-0-54-96-release/), take a build whose version code is 347415262, 347415267, 347415268, 347415280, 347415281, 347415284, 347415285, 347415295, 347415299, 347415301, 347415302, 347415333, 347415337, 347415348, 347415350, 347415351, 347415352, 347415354 or 347415355. APKMirror shows the code for each download, and a build posted there after this release may not be supported yet.
2. In Morphe Manager (2.5.0 or newer), open **Sources** and refresh HushMessenger. The card should say **98 patches**.
3. Patch Messenger again and install it over your current one. Your settings carry over.

Patching on a computer? `patches-0.30.0.mpp` below is the same bundle for Morphe Desktop 2.1.0 or newer. It's a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` and its signature let you check the download, and the README says how.

### What was checked

- The full test suite, plus a patch run against all 19 Messenger 587.0.0.54.96 builds on file.
- Morphe Desktop patched and rebuilt one APK from each of the 4 build families.
- An APK patched from this exact bundle was installed on an emulator on Android API 32, signed in to Messenger. A chat, the inbox, both HushMessenger settings tabs, the message log, auto reply, Messenger's own settings, story settings and contact settings all opened, with no crashes.

SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram.Changelog:
HushTelegram v0.0.25 has 82 patches for Telegram 13.2.1, both the Google Play build (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72911) and telegram.org's (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72919), so the two builds are on the same version now. It's still on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, and Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer is all you need. The bundle is signed from this release on, so Morphe Manager shows who signed it when you add or update the source. Most of it came from your reports, and it changes something for #7, #27, #46, #48, #52, #58, #63, #65, #66, #67, #70 and #71. Free proxies keeps the fastest public MTProto proxies in Telegram's list for you. Ghost mode can make exceptions for the chats you pick, and the message menu gains Hide for me, Delete for them and Forward as plain text. Every new switch starts off, except the two that stop a photo from going out uncropped or with the wrong caption.

New in this release

- `Free proxies`, under Chat list. Turn it on and HushTelegram downloads a public list of MTProto proxies every 6 hours, times them and keeps the 10 fastest in Telegram's proxy list. Telegram connects through the fastest and moves to another by itself when one stops answering, unless you're using a proxy of your own. `Find free proxies now` runs it right away, even with the switch off, and then only adds them to the list. Proxies you saved yourself are never touched. The phone number screen also always has Telegram's proxy button now, so you can add a proxy before you sign in, which helps where Telegram is blocked (#66).

- `Proxy order`, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Drag your proxies into the order you like or pin a few on top, and Telegram's own proxy screen lists them that way instead of re-sorting by speed every time it saves. A free proxy you pin becomes yours, so the next refresh won't remove it. `Sort by speed` drops your order and keeps only the pins. With HushTelegram paused the screen goes back to Telegram's order (#71).

- `Your proxy lists`, under Chat list below Find free proxies. Add the https addresses of up to 5 proxy lists you trust, pages of t.me/proxy or tg://proxy links, and Free proxies reads those instead of the public list, timing them all together and keeping the 10 fastest. A list that can't be read is skipped. Empty the box to go back to the public list. The addresses stay out of settings files (#71).

- `Proxy in the chat list menu`, under Chat list and off by default. The menu at the top of the chat list always has Proxy, so your saved proxies are one tap away. Telegram only puts it there while a proxy is on or in a country where Telegram is blocked (#67).

- `Ghost mode` has two new switches in Privacy, both off by default. `Read after you reply` sends the read receipt Ghost mode held back in a chat once you send a message there, so your other devices stop showing that chat as unread. `Read receipts button` puts a double check at the top of the chat list that sends every read receipt Ghost mode is holding for the account you're on. Held receipts last until Telegram restarts.

- `Ghost mode exceptions`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. The chats you pick get the opposite of Ghost mode: while it's on they read, type and watch stories as usual, and while it's off they keep back what the Ghost mode switches keep back, view counts included. Pick them in `Exception chats`, or long press chats in the chat list and use `Ghost mode exception` in the three dots menu. Online status isn't one chat's, so it follows Ghost mode everywhere (#71).

- `Fake typing`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. Long press chats in the chat list and pick `Fake typing` in the three dots menu, and they show you typing for 10 minutes or until you pick them again. It works with Ghost mode on too. Secret chats can't show it (#71).

- `Instant lock`, in Privacy and off by default. With a Telegram passcode set, Telegram locks a second or two after you leave it instead of waiting out your Auto-lock time. Your Auto-lock choice stays as it is and comes back when you turn the switch off.

- `Don't notify contacts`, in Privacy and off by default. When you sign up a phone number that's never used Telegram, the people who have it saved don't get the "joined Telegram" notice. Turn it on before you sign up. On a fresh install, long press the app icon to reach the Hush settings. Accounts that already exist aren't affected.

- `Suppress screenshot notification`, a new patch with its switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, off by default. Telegram stops telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats.

- `Unlock Premium features`, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram on your phone treats your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits stay the same.

- `Bypass channel restrictions`, in Privacy and off by default. Channels and chats that turn off forwarding, copying and saving let you do all three. Their stories open up too, so you can share and screenshot them, and save them wherever Telegram lets you save other stories (#52). Its second switch, `Open restricted channels`, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them (#58).

- `Bypass integrity check`, in Privacy and off by default. Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator.

- `Send photos and videos in the best quality`, a fifth switch under `Faster downloads` in HushTelegram settings > Playback, off by default. Photos go out in HD and videos at their own size and quality without a trip to the quality button, and you can still lower one before you send it (#63).

- `Auto-forwarding rules` forwards now. Under its switch in Privacy, `Forwarding rules` lists your rules for the account you're on, and `Add rule` picks the chat to watch, the chat to send to and whether every message goes or only ones with a photo, video or file. Only messages other people send go out. A forward from any account you're signed in to never goes out again, and neither does a copy of a message a rule already sent to that chat, so rules pointing at each other can't loop, even across two accounts or through channels. Saved Messages can take forwards but isn't offered as a chat to watch. Chats you can't post in, Replies, Telegram's own account and deleted accounts aren't offered to send to, and at most 20 forwards leave a minute. Off by default.

- `Never send an uncropped photo`, under Conversations and on by default. If Telegram can't finish a crop, say the photo hasn't loaded yet or there's no memory left for the cropped copy, the editor stays open with a short note instead of sending the whole photo. Tap Done or Send again to retry, or Cancel to leave the photo uncropped. Live photos get the same check, including when the still can't be read from its file. Videos crop the way they always did.

- `My messages`, under Conversations and off by default. A group's menu at the top gets My messages, which opens the chat's search on the messages you sent there, so you can step through them or see them as a list. Channels and private chats don't get it. Morphe Manager lists it under Search (#71).

- `Text direction`, under Conversations and off by default. Select text in the message box and its menu gets Right to left and Left to right, which start each selected line with an invisible direction mark so it reads that way for everyone. Picking the other one later swaps the mark. Control character opens the list of invisible marks Telegram Desktop has, like RLM or ZWJ, and puts the one you pick where your selection was. Morphe Manager lists it in a new Writing group along with Use normal paste (#71).

- `Hide for me`, a new item in the message menu, behind its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu in Conversations, off by default. Long press a message, pick Hide for me, and it leaves the chat on this phone, its whole album with it. Nothing goes to Telegram, so everyone else still has it, and it stays out each time you open the chat. Show hidden messages, right below the switch, brings them all back, and so does turning the switch off (#71).

- `Forward as plain text` joins the message menu on its own switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. Pick it on a message you could forward, choose a chat, and the words land there as a brand new message from you. Bold, links and the original sender's name stay behind, and custom emoji turn into the regular emoji they stand for (#71).

- `Delete for them` is a new message menu item for your own messages in chats and groups, on its own switch below Hide for me, off by default. It deletes the message, album included, for everyone else and keeps your copy here with the "deleted" mark Keep deleted messages uses, even while that switch is off. It only shows while Telegram would still let you delete for everyone, so not on old messages in basic groups, and never in Saved Messages, secret chats, bots or channels. Clear kept messages removes those copies too (#71).

- `Lyrics and song dates`, a new patch with two switches in Playback, both off by default. `Lyrics in the music player` puts Lyrics in the player's menu. It looks the song up on lrclib.net and, when the lyrics are timed, keeps the current line in view as the song plays. `Dates on your profile songs` notes the day you add a song to your profile and shows it after the artist in your profile's song list. The days stay on this phone, so songs added earlier or from another device don't get one (#71).

- `Chat preview buttons`, under Chat list and off by default. Press and hold a chat and the menu under its preview ends with Open chat, which opens the chat the rest of the way, and Close preview, which puts the preview away (#71).

- `Screenshot selected messages` is a new switch under Add Repeat to the message menu, off by default. It puts a Screenshot button in the bar that shows while you pick messages. Tap it and the messages are saved to Pictures/Telegram as one picture, the way the chat shows them, with the wallpaper, date headers and times. Every message you picked has to be on screen. Secret chats never get a picture, and chats that don't allow saving only do when `Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving` is on (#71).

- `Keep captions with their photos`, under Conversations and on by default. When the photos you pick in the attach menu each have their own caption, unpicking the first one or dragging another photo in front of it used to put the first photo's caption on the new first photo. Now every caption stays with its own photo.

- `Folder icons on tabs` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default, that takes an app restart. Each folder tab above the chat list gets a small icon in front of its name, in the name's own color: a chat bubble for All Chats, a person, group, channel or bot for a folder of only that kind of chat, Telegram's unread and unmuted icons for folders that drop read or muted chats, and a plain folder for the rest. With a pack picked under `Folder icons`, the tabs use that pack's icon for the folder's name instead.

- `Open a chat by ID`, under Look and feel below the Show user and chat IDs switches. Type the number from a profile's ID row and it opens that person, group or channel, as long as this app has already seen it, say someone who wrote in a group you opened. Bot-style IDs like -100 followed by the channel's number work too (#71).

Fixes

- `Hide sender names when forwarding` covers the Share sheet now, and forwards to several chats at once, which still went out with the original author (#70). The Share sheet's send menu starts on Hide sender's name, and you can switch it back there. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender.

- With `Turn videos only from the full screen button` on, a video you put in full screen with the button stays sideways on 13.2 instead of standing back up as soon as you turn the phone (#27).

- `Save to Downloads` in the message menu saves every photo of an album, not just the one you long-pressed (#46).

- `Save downloaded files` no longer logs an error in its diagnostics whenever a profile photo or a sticker finishes downloading (#27).

- `Save downloaded files` no longer puts one file's contents under another file's name (#7). When two different files had the same name and size, Telegram could open the first one's file for the second instead of downloading it, and the copy in Download/Telegram came out with the wrong contents. That second file now stays out of Download/Telegram, and so does any named file Telegram finds already saved instead of downloading it. Files whose names end in .enc get copied as well, where they used to fail.

- The account rows in HushTelegram settings and the checks that tell your own accounts apart no longer log an error on 13.2.1 from Google Play. They only look at the four account slots that build has.

- Turning `UnifiedPush notifications` off, or picking another push app, when your phone couldn't save the change (a full phone, say) no longer leaves the row saying the push app ended the sign-up. Turning it back on signs up again, and a move to another app goes ahead once the old one lets go. A refusal, an address or an end the old app sends in the middle of a move can't undo it anymore, and Telegram goes back to Google's push until the new app sends its address.

- With large text, the HushTelegram settings list no longer jumps a few pixels when you go back from a search. The top bar used to come back a little shorter after a long title had to shrink to fit.

- With Telegram set to Português (Brasil), HushTelegram settings and messages come out in Portuguese. They were in English, because Telegram runs that language with no region and only the Brazilian table had Portuguese text.

- In German, the text under `Receive only mode` and `Power off accounts` says "du" like the rest of HushTelegram settings.

- A settings search while an import, an export or a diagnostic report is running shows the same rows it shows the rest of the time. Searching "Import settings" during an import used to list `Export settings` too, since that row said "Importing settings" for the moment.

- With `Hide reactions under messages` on, a new reaction to your message gets marked as seen once you scroll to it. The heart in the chat list and the reactions button in the chat used to stay there for good. Telegram's pop-up animation for that reaction no longer plays over the hidden row either (#48).

Other changes

- The telegram.org web build moves from 13.2.0 (72809) to 13.2.1 (72919). Both builds now track Telegram 13.2.1.

- `Ghost mode` lets channel reads go out now, so a channel you read on this phone shows as read on your other devices too. Nobody in a channel can see who read what, so they learn nothing. Groups and private chats stay unread everywhere else, since there the read is what people would see (#65).

- With `Ghost mode` and `No read receipts` on, opening a channel post, or one forwarded into a chat, no longer adds your view to its count. The counts still load. Turning on `Hide online status`, or Ghost mode while it's on, now shows you offline on every signed-in account right away instead of whenever Telegram would have timed you out (#71).

- The patch bundle is signed now. Morphe Manager shows "Signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc" on the HushTelegram source and remembers that key, so a later bundle signed with any other key, or not signed at all, gets refused instead of loaded.

Behind the scenes

- `scripts/name-table.ps1` writes a Telegram build's name table, the map from 13.1.1's names to the ones R8 gave the build. Run it again on a build that already has a table and it keeps the rows people added by hand and lets them win over anything it matched, so 72919's table comes back unchanged.

- The build signs the bundle when `HUSHTELEGRAM_BUNDLE_SIGNING_KEY` holds the private key (Morphe's shared `MORPHE_SIGNING_KEY` is the fallback), and refuses a key that isn't the one `morphe-signing.pub` publishes. Without one the build still works and says the bundle is unsigned. `verifyBundle` checks the signature with Morphe's own verifier and fails a bundle signed by another key, or an unsigned one when the build had a key. A release won't go out with a bundle the published key didn't sign, and the index gains `public_key`.

- `verifyBundle` fails a bundle holding any class file newer than Java 17 (major 61), which Morphe's patcher won't load. The bundle's classes are Java 8 and 11 today, so a toolchain change that crosses the line now stops the build instead of reaching Manager.

- The host test runner's Netty moves from 4.1.138.Final to 4.1.140.Final, which carries Netty's HTTP smuggling and decoder fixes. Only the tests on the build machine use it. Nothing in the bundle does.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer. It's the same version 0.0.24 needed.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram. If you already have it, refresh the source. From this release on Morphe Manager shows it as signed by d7d6 bd99 8faf 7bcc.
3. Get Telegram 13.2.1. From Google Play that's `org.telegram.messenger` with version code 72911, which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. telegram.org's build is `org.telegram.messenger.web` with version code 72919, but the [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) there already hands out 13.2.2, which this release doesn't cover yet. Get 13.2.1 from Telegram's own [Telegram APKs for Android](https://t.me/TAndroidAPK) channel instead. The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.24? Patch the same 13.2.1 build you used last time (telegram.org users move up from 13.2.0) and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. On phones where Firebase notifications don't come through, try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. It turns those two on for you unless you've set them yourself.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The Ways in section on that page decides which of those (plus the side menu row and the icon shortcut) stay.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

What was checked

All 2327 runtime tests passed locally, and all 664 patch tests passed too (166 unit tests and 498 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 82 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.1 (version code 72919) and to the Google Play build of 13.2.1 (version code 72911). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, resource table, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S22, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings and the Changed switches page. That's 22 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either.

SysAdminDoc/HushFeed.Changelog:
Hushfeed v0.82.0 has 147 patches for global TikTok 47.7.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It's built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer before you patch (or use morphe-desktop 2.1.1 on a computer). Older ones won't load it.

TikTok moves to 47.7.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key. Your login and settings carry over. You can jump to a date on your Liked grid now, and search what's on your Liked and Favorites tabs. Long comments can fold down to a few lines. `Pause before the feed` puts a short countdown in front of For You, and Hushfeed can tell you when a newer release is out. The settings come in Thai too.

New in this release

- Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.7.3, and only that one. 47.7.2 isn't supported anymore. Grab the 47.7.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over.
- Hushfeed builds on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 2.1.1 on a computer. Older Managers refuse the bundle.
- `Jump to a date on Liked grids` puts a button in the Liked grid's top corner. Pick a year, then a month or the whole year, and your likes start there, so older ones load without scrolling through everything newer. Newest likes in the same menu goes back. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, under the grid sort rows (#350).
- `Show where commenters are from` also checks the country field on a commenter's account, and uses it only when it holds a two letter code (#201).
- `Long press on Profile opens my watch history` makes holding the Profile tab show the watch history kept on your phone, so the long press on For You can keep opening Hushfeed settings. A tap on Profile works as before. It starts off, sits under `Keep my own watch history` and needs the `Feed tab navigation` patch (#172).
- `Long-press Profile to switch accounts` brings back holding the Profile tab to pick another of your accounts, for accounts where TikTok left that hold out. A tap on Profile works as before, and while `Long-press Profile for Watch history` is on, that one gets the hold. It starts off, lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs and takes a TikTok restart (#388).
- `Discover in the bottom bar` puts Discover where Friends sits in the bottom bar, the layout TikTok gives Indonesia, and your region and feed stay as they are. It starts off, lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs and takes a TikTok restart (#98).
- `Friends in the top tabs` moves Friends up to the tabs along the top of the feed, just left of Following, and Discover takes its spot in the bottom bar, the layout TikTok gives Indonesia. Your region and feed stay as they are (#98).
- The Feature Gate Lab can override experiments TikTok reads as a whole object, like the home tab layout. It couldn't reach those before. An override changes only the fields you give it, and it still applies when TikTok sent your account nothing for that experiment (#98).
- The diagnostic report names the code other patch bundles added to your TikTok, or says there's none. A bundle built from the same template as Hushfeed, with the same package names, no longer counts as Hushfeed's own code. When the last crash happened inside one of them, it says which, even when TikTok's own code passed the error along. When a report runs long, `Copy quick report` now drops only the oldest events and keeps every other part whole, this one included. It also lists the last five times Android closed TikTok and why, where it used to show only the last one (#275).
- The diagnostic export has a Font section. It shows which font TikTok's text went out in, whether an imported font loaded (and if it didn't, why), and the Samsung font style on Galaxy phones (#346).
- Settings an update adds get a small dot after their name in Hushfeed settings, and the closed section they sit in gets one too, so you can spot what's new. A dot goes away after the visit that shows it, and a fresh install starts with none (#349).
- `Startup message` shows a message you write each time TikTok opens, with an optional title. Turn off `Close with Back or a tap outside` and only its OK button closes it. Its `Don't show again` button hides that message until you change its title or text, or install or update TikTok again. Rotating the phone or changing TikTok's theme keeps a message you haven't closed on screen, and doesn't bring back one you have. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > App (#347).
- `Check for Hushfeed updates` tells you in TikTok when a newer Hushfeed is out. Once a day at most, when TikTok opens, it asks GitHub for the latest release, and a newer one gets a card listing the first few things it changes. Update opens Morphe Manager (or the release page if Manager isn't installed) and Dismiss hides the card for that release. The request carries your Hushfeed version and nothing else, and the switch starts off. Find it in Hushfeed settings > App, under the startup message rows (#377).
- With a color picked in `AMOLED dark theme`'s options, Profile, Inbox and TikTok's other full pages take that color too. Before, they stayed black. The light look and the video feed don't change (#348).
- `Block P2P video relay` also takes out the LIVE relay's two leftover libraries, about 1 MB more. The split APK bundle never had them, so nothing changes for those installs (#70).
- `Bend the video at the edges` makes the glass pill's rim bend the blurred video behind it the way the edge of real glass does, and it gives the colors there a small lift. It sits under `Blur the video behind the bar`, starts off and needs Android 13 or newer (#231).
- Three new switches under the ring switches, `Remove rings on the feed`, `Remove rings in comments` and `Remove rings on profiles`, pick where the story and LIVE rings come off. All three start on, so nothing changes until you turn one off (#351).
- `Accent color` has two new options, `Like color` and `Save color`. They paint the heart on a video you liked and the bookmark on one you saved, in the feed and in their tap animations, with a preset or a color code you type. They work in light, dark and AMOLED, and with or without a new accent. Both start on TikTok's own red and yellow, which changes nothing (#369).
- `Hide On this day` takes the On this day memory off the front of the Inbox's stories tray, and the stories after it move up into its place. It starts off and sits under `Hide stories tray` in Hushfeed settings > Inbox (#358).
- `Hide profile pictures in comments` takes the commenter's picture off every comment and reply. The name and the comment move over to the left, so there's no empty space where the picture was. It starts off, sits under `Hide the thumbs down on comments` in Hushfeed settings > Comments and takes a TikTok restart (#352).
- `Custom hold speed` under Playback takes any speed you type, like 1.8 or 2.3, for holding a video and for the pull-down lock under it. It takes the place of `Speed while you hold the video`, and leaving it empty keeps that row's pick (#357).
- `Check for already-saved videos` covers `Save the original sound` too. Save a sound you already have, even from a different video that uses it, and you get Open or Save again instead of a second copy (#356).
- `Phone model for effects` under `Report a newer phone to effects` lets you pick the phone the effects server hears about, since an effect turned down for one phone can open for another. Tap it for a list of recent Galaxy and Pixel phones, or pick `Type another model` at the bottom and enter any model yourself. Left alone it stays the Galaxy S24 Ultra (#176).
- `Keep clear screen in the next LIVE` carries clear screen from one LIVE room to the next one you swipe to, so the chat, gifts and buttons stay hidden until you turn clear screen off. It starts off and sits in Hushfeed settings > Playback, next to `Offer clear screen in every LIVE room` (#354).
- `LIVE feed countries` under Hushfeed settings > Region asks the LIVE feed for rooms from the countries you list, like BR, MX, taking turns page by page. TikTok doesn't say which country a room comes from, so this steers the feed instead of filtering it, and a room from somewhere else can still turn up. Nothing else in TikTok sees the change. It needs the `Region spoof` patch but none of its switches, and it starts empty (#355).
- The diagnostic export has a Captions line. For each For You video it says whether TikTok sent caption tracks, and when it sent none, the reason TikTok gave, like not authorized or language not supported. That way an account whose captions never show can tell whether TikTok sends any at all (#217).
- Two new switches in Hushfeed settings > Comments, `Hide the close button in comments` and `Hide the expand button in comments`, each take one button off the top of the comments, and the buttons beside it move over into its place. Back or a swipe down still closes comments. TikTok only shows the expand button to some accounts. Both start off (#371).
- `Hide the search button on the feed` also hides the magnifying glass TikTok puts over the shrunken video while comments are open (#371).
- `Invisible controls button` puts a small eye at the top left of the main feed. Tap it and the buttons, caption and tabs turn invisible but keep working where they are, which helps against burn-in on OLED screens. Tap the eye again and they're back. Your choice sticks across videos and restarts. The eye stays off other tabs, comments, Clear display and videos you open from a profile or search, and Pause brings everything back. `Keep the caption in sight` under it leaves the creator's name, the caption and the music line showing. Both start off and sit in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, under `Keep faded controls in Clear display` (#374).
- `Hide Send to new group` takes the gray Send to new group button off the share sheet when you've picked two or more people, so Send separately is the only button left. It starts off and sits under `Hide the Send to row` in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet (#375).
- `AMOLED dark theme` has a switch now. `AMOLED dark mode` in Hushfeed settings > App starts on, and turning it off brings back TikTok's own dark grays after a restart, so you can keep the patch in and still pick plain dark mode. The color you picked in the patch's options stays for when it's on. Pause Hushfeed turns it off too (#372).
- `Make sticker` in a video's share sheet opens TikTok's own sticker editor for that video, so you can trim it, add text and save it as an animated sticker, even on videos where TikTok doesn't show its Create sticker button. If the editor can't open, the video's cover becomes the sticker like before (#214).
- `Automatically record LIVEs you enter` starts recording a LIVE's stream the moment you walk into the room. Swipe on to the next LIVE and that one starts recording too, while the one you left finishes saving in the background. Tap Stop and it stays stopped until you leave and come back.
